batch.description: Transcribed 2026-10-31 from the compiler-solved CamScanner scan of the JU D Unit 2014-2015 paper in the AdmissionWar/Google Drive PDF ju-d-2014-2015-set2.pdf (6 pp.). ⚠ LISTING-VS-PRINTED SET CODE DISCREPANCY: the Drive listing calls this file 'Set-2', but the printed header box on p.1 reads 'SET CODE: 3/4' — a merged pair code (Satt Academy's banks for this session are likewise merged pairs সেট ১/২ and ৩/৪). The printed code governs, so the paper id is ju-d-2014-2015-set3-4. The compilation prints each question with a ব্যাখ্যা and a boxed 'উত্তরঃ X' key; option labels are Bangla (ক)-(ঘ) for most questions and Latin (a)-(d) for some English/numeric ones, while the key boxes always use the Bangla letter (ক=a, খ=b, গ=c, ঘ=d). Printed header: session ২০১৪-২০১৫, D-ইউনিট (জীববিজ্ঞান অনুষদ), 60 minutes, full marks 80, negative marking ০.২০ per wrong answer. The compilation prints no subject section headings; subjects were assigned per question by content (Biology split into Botany/Zoology by content block: Botany = printed Q17-36, Zoology = Q37-56), preserving printed order and numbering throughout. 80 questions: 78 keyed, 2 keyless (Q18 — key letter washed out in the scan and no ব্যাখ্যা printed; Q48 — key letter cut off at the page edge and no ব্যাখ্যা printed), 0 dual keys, 0 printed no-correct-option dispositions. Transcribed visually from 300 dpi renders read as quadrant tiles with native-resolution zooms for doubtful glyphs; render integrity verified by file hashes (p-1.png SHA-256 b8875d6beea2dd8985516391a7a0f12dba490f356c5d90c91230497244e002c2) and by crop-vs-full-page consistency throughout. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.notes: CamScanner scan of a compiler-solved reprint (per-question ব্যাখ্যা with a boxed 'উত্তরঃ X' key after most questions; X is a Bangla letter ক/খ/গ/ঘ even where the options themselves carry Latin labels). Aggregator footer 'For More Question Bank Visit www.admissionwar.com'; diagonal 'Admission War' watermarks are the aggregator's, not part of the question paper. Handwritten/reader marks are not keys. Two-column layout. Downloaded from the AdmissionWar Google Drive archive for the admission-research project. The Drive filename says set2, but the printed SET CODE box on p.1 reads 3/4 — the printed code governs the paper identity.

examRules.sourceNote: Printed header (PDF p.1): ১ম বর্ষ স্নাতক সম্মান ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৪-২০১৫; D-ইউনিট, জীববিজ্ঞান অনুষদ, জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়; boxed 'SET CODE: 3/4'; সময়ঃ ৬০ মিনিট, পূর্ণমানঃ ৮০. Printed instructions: (প্রতিটি ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২০ নম্বর কাটা যাবে। প্রশ্নপত্রে উত্তর চিহ্নিত করা যাবে না) পরীক্ষার শুরুতে OMR শিটের নির্ধারিত স্থানে নিচের দু'টি বাক্য লিখতে হবে — ১। নিয়ন্ত্রিত জীবন মানেই সুস্থ জীবন ২। Disciplined life means healthy life.
